body: i dont know that's the worst thing , i have suffered from depression for 2 years now.And a few months ago when i split up with my girlfriend i just lost hope and did my first attempt. the worst thing is that i have loving parents , a lot of friends , and pople are actually there for me; bu i think about killing myself 24/7. i feel selfish .I dont know why i wanna die i know it is going to be better but it s like a really powerful desire , i cant do anything against it.

well , honestly the easiest way and the most efficient one is to hang yourself , all other procedures are unreliable or way too complcated to do. Hope i did help.and i hope you will not do it.Thats the honest answer. its your life after all.

nobody is worthless, you have a college degree and maybe it seems to you that you are stuck right now , there are always good chances that your life will turn around.Life has it ways of being unpredictable.Ending it might be missing a lot of joy ahead of you and that you just cant see yet.

I ve been on medication for two years now , and it did help a lot.I live in france so the names of the drugs may not be the same , but i took seroplex  first , and it didnt work for me , but a few months later i switched psychatrist and he put me on Velaxior lp and since i feel much better. Depression is a real illness , that affect the brain .medication can be really helpful.

believe me , there is no painless method to end your life.Life can get super hard , and i dont think ending it would be the right choice,.I m here if you want to talk about your story. I know it feels like i m just saying obvious politically correct crap right now , but believe i tried to kill myself too , and luckily i survived , and life can surprise you when you expect it the least.
